claims.text: ELECTRA's binary classification head labels tokens as either 'good' gaps or 'bad' gaps based on a token classification objective.
The model uses a linear layer to classify each token as a gap or non-gap, which is part of its discriminator head.
The classification is based on the performance of the model in predicting gaps, with a threshold for positive class confidence scores.
